verdicts.reason: A is a shrunk copy. The quote is squeezed onto one line at about 7px, so it can't be read in a 320x50 banner. The quote mark is a speck, the product is cut off at the right edge, the SOLSTICE logo is gone, and there is dead space below the text. B is more readable: the quote wraps onto two lines and the yellow quote mark is kept. Its flaws are that the bold yellow attribution is as heavy as the headline, so they compete. The attribution sits left-aligned in a different column from the centered quote. The product is reduced to a thin sliver jammed against the right edge, and the logo is missing.
